speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing fever and abdominal tenderness after giving birth; can you tell me how many days postpartum this started and what your temperature is? Additionally, have you noticed any unusual discharge from your uterus or pain during breastfeeding?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis with possible associated urinary retention or ileus. The combination of fever, uterine tenderness, prolonged labor, and decreased bowel sounds suggests a severe pelvic infection, potentially complicated by urinary tract involvement. I will proceed with obtaining blood cultures, a complete blood count, and a urinalysis to confirm the diagnosis and guide antibiotic therapy.
